nom: COSRX 5 PDRN Collagen Vitalizing Hydrogel Eye Patch

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with acne-prone, sensitive skin reports no breakouts at all during a month of daily use, describing the patches as gentle and soothing rather than heavy or sticky.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report immediate, visible hydration and smoother, plumper under-eye skin, though one reviewer says it only helps some with dryness and wishes it did more.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no irritation around the eyes at all, including one with sensitive, acne-prone skin who found the patches gentle and soothing throughout a month of daily use.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report a noticeable reduction in the appearance of dark circles, with one calling it the only product that has ever helped hers; one reviewer, however, says it only helps some with dark circles and wishes the effect were stronger.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports no breakouts at all during a month of use.

aspects.libelle: Patches can slide before fully setting
Curved shape can poke the inner eye corner
Included spatula hard to use, grabs multiple patches
Container seals well, keeps patches from drying out
Some prefer eye cream convenience for daily use

extraits.texte: Undereye area looks great after these. Very comfortable after they dry a little, I forget I'm wearing them. A little messy but they provide a nice spatula, and the container has a great seal so they don't dry out. Only star off because they are too curved - the point kind of sticks into my inner eye so I have to slide it farther down to avoid that and it leaves a gap of skin uncovered
Helping some with dryness and dark circles. Could be better for dark circles

extraits.titre: A Quick Boost for Tired Eyes - With a Learning Curve
extraits.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by how quickly these eye patches worked - I noticed visible effectiveness after the very first use. The hydration and smoothing effect are immediate, which made them a great addition to my routine over the past 30 days.I do understand that hydrogel patches can be delicate and sometimes break, but I personally found the included spatula a bit inconvenient. It's difficult to grab just one patch at a time, and I often ended up pulling out two or more. Tweezers would make the experience much easier and more precise.There is a subtle scent, but it's barely noticeable and definitely not irritating. My skin didn't break out at all during the month I used these, which is a big win for my acne-prone and sensitive skin. They feel gentle and soothing, never heavy or sticky.These are the first eye patches I've ever tried, and while I really like the instant results, I realized I still prefer the convenience of an eye cream pump. Creams are quicker, easier, and fit better into a busy routine. The patches feel like a nice self-care moment, but not something I'll reach for daily.Overall, these eye patches deliver on effectiveness and are friendly to sensitive skin - I just wish the application process were a bit more convenient.
I'm soooo in love with this product. . . this is the only thing that help my dark under eyes. . .

Of all the under eye treatments I've tried over the years, not only does this one work the best, the results are almost immediately visible. Without any irritation in or around the eyes, I noticed much smoother skin and a reduction in appearance of dark circles that I wasn't expecting. On first application, use the enclosed separation tool so that you don't end up applying multiple stacked gel pads to your under eye area. This is one of those products that genuinely surprised and impressed me.

I've been using the COSRX 5 PDRN Collagen Vitalizing Hydrogel Eye Patch and it's such a nice treat for my under-eyes :u1F90D:The patches feel instantly cooling and soothing, which is perfect when my eyes look tired or puffy. After about 15-20 minutes, my under-eye area looks more hydrated, smoother, and slightly plumper.They also sit well without sliding too much, so I can still move around while wearing them. It's become my go-to for a quick refresh, especially on low-sleep days.

reserve: With only 10 of 13 reviews available, this is a small sample, though the reports on hydration and dark-circle reduction are fairly consistent across reviewers.
